domains.name: Documentation and Portfolio Development (Integrated Across Phases)

standards.text: The learners demonstrate understanding of creative production processes, artistic documentation methods, and project management in developing and presenting discipline-specific creative works.
The learners can apply practical skills through supervised hands-on activities that promote skill development, personal growth, and preparation for future career opportunities.

contentStandards.text: The learners demonstrate understanding of creative production processes, artistic documentation methods, and project management in developing and presenting discipline-specific creative works.

performanceStandards.text: The learners can apply practical skills through supervised hands-on activities that promote skill development, personal growth, and preparation for future career opportunities.

competencies.text: propose discipline-specific creative productions grounded in artistic research and cultural contexts;
plan collaborative andcreative productions using industry-based processes within their chosen art forms;
execute discipline-specific creative productions using appropriate artistic, technical, and technological processes;
present discipline-specific creative works for public engagement following professional standards;
document the creative production process and outputs using industry-standard formats within the chosen discipline; and
evaluate discipline-specific creative productions through critique and reflective analyses.
